verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim self-hosting with local graph engine, local embeddings, and local LLM as a single self-contained binary with no cloud dependency (supermemory-docs-7/8/16/31), which directly matches the story. However, there's no independent/community corroboration of local-model self-hosting working hands-on, no detail on which local LLMs/embedding models are supported, and no probe evidence testing the self-hosted binary itself. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of the self-hosted binary running fully offline, documented list of supported local model backends, independent confirmation beyond first-party docs.
